name: interactive-fan-game
description: 影像辨識畫圈對決節奏遊戲（澎湖縣龍門國小）
author: youming

scripts.start:electron: cross-env ELECTRON=1 vite build --outDir dist-electron && electron .
scripts.dist:dir: cross-env ELECTRON=1 vite build --outDir dist-electron && electron-builder --win dir
scripts.dist:exe: cross-env ELECTRON=1 vite build --outDir dist-electron && electron-builder --win portable
